title: Young Woman Mary Rose Relaxing in Lawn Chair 1940s B&W Vintage Photo
description: A 1940s black and white vintage snapshot photo depicting a smiling young woman identified on the back as Mary Rose reclining on a wooden folding lawn chair in a sunny yard. She is wearing a short-sleeved cardigan sweater, pleated skirt, bobby socks, and oxford shoes, capturing casual mid-century American home life and fashion.
